Name: Isaiah Revived
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
I received a request to update [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19790]Custom NPC Isaiah[/url] by  Velocityissin and his permissions were open so here he is!

Isaiah is a museum worker/librarian who moved into town couple years before you. He is passionate about history and in his free time listens to metal music to wind down. He's pretty awkward at first, but will warm up as you get to know him.

Isaiah has a lot of dialouge about the history and lore of the Valley. Most of it is revealed if he is gifted an artifact. He has a unique response for all artifacts. (Except the Dwarf Scrolls, which share the same one, and the Island Field Office ones, since they're not technically artifacts.) He will refuse them as a gift and tell you a couple lines about them. 

This mod also includes optional seasonal portraits and sprites. He is romanceable as well.

Major changes from the original:

The biggest change I've made is that his room at the museum was incompatible with anything that changed the museum like any extra space mods. So I've moved his room to one of the basement rooms from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47209]Saloon Attic and Basement[/url]. He's in the room directly to the right of the staircase. This also makes him compatible with all expansions!
